headlines:
Raise a kid who says
“Let me try.”
subtitles:
“har baar mere saath hi kyun?”
why does this always happen to me?

“Laa, main khila deti hoon.”
Here, let me feed you.

“Laa, main baandh deta hoon.”
Here, let me tie them.

“Tu rehne de, padhai kar.
Main bana deti hoon.”
Leave it, go study. I’ll make it.

“Kitna sanskari bachcha hai…
aapki har baat maanta hai.”
Such a well-behaved child. Always listens to you.

cta.line: for 5 things a 2-year-old can do alone
